claim_boundary: This audit proves the pinned australia-ngsa-mercury file contract, adapter parse and registered target denominator. It does not turn discrete source observations into continuous geographic coverage or cross-method comparability.
limitations: The product reports total Hg in dry-weight ng/g for less-than-75-micrometre top and bottom outlet sediment; it is not a regular national grid.
Total mercury was measured directly on about 100 mg by Milestone tri-cell DMA-80 without acid digestion, following USEPA Method 7473.
The header reports a 0.01 ng Hg mass detection limit, not a concentration detection limit; the adapter does not incorrectly store 0.01 ng/g as a row threshold.
TOS and BOS horizons and all duplicate codes remain explicit. QA/QC duplicates are not counted as independent sites.
Coordinates use GDA94 geographic coordinates (EPSG:4283); canonical fields are created only through gda94-geographic-wgs84-identity-v1 and raw values remain preserved.
The publisher does not report positional accuracy; coordinate decimal resolution is not treated as accuracy.
